name: Mushroom Barley Bake
ingredients: 1 tsp dried thyme and 1 tbsp soy sauce
steps: Sauté the onion, garlic and mushrooms in the oil for 6 minutes.
Mix with the barley, tofu, thyme, soy sauce and pepper in a deep baking dish.
Pour in the hot stock and cover tightly with foil.
Bake for 50 minutes, until the barley is tender and the liquid absorbed. Finish with parsley.
note: An easy hands-off bake; barley supplies soluble fibre.
